name: knovid
description: KnoVid — video to knowledge: transcripts, speaker labels, knowledge graphs, notes, quizzes, and Q&A

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:api: node scripts/python.js -m uvicorn --app-dir backend main:app --reload --port 8000 --env-file backend/.env
scripts.setup:python: cd backend && node ../scripts/python.js -m pip install --no-build-isolation -r requirements.txt
